text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a drop in prefix cache hit-rate after yesterday's kernel selection change. Ops alert attached.

dev-bot: [perf-regression] model=rw-l6 kernel=autotuned-3 -> 8% drop in prefix-kv hit-rate across p99 short-context requests

alex: Repro steps: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-RW-Model: rw-l6" -H "X-RW-Client: cli-test" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello","stream":false}'

mira: Are we canonicalizing cache keys the same way? We changed normalization in kernel selection branch (strip trailing newline + compress whitespace) — that may change key boundaries.

jordan: Also batching heuristics might be merging small requests into multi-ask batches and that can shift the 'prefix' we cache. If the prefix is now longer/shorter, hit-rate moves.

alex: I profiled KV cache calls; stack shows key computed as sha256(prefix + model + seq) but with runtime kernel we now include attention window id. Here's snippet:
```
key = sha256(prefix + '|' + model + '|' + kernel_variant)
```
That kernel_variant addition might be new.

mira: Oof. Kernel variant in key makes cache colder across kernel rollouts. We should make kernel variant optional in keying and fall back to model family.

sam: For short-term mitigation we can expose an opt-in header so clients control whether kernel-specific keying is used. Suggest: `X-RW-Prefix-Cache: opt-in|legacy|strict`

jordan: +1. Also add SDK flag: `client.prefetch.cacheKeying='legacy'` so customers can opt-out of kernel-variant keying until we stabilize.

opsbot: @channel incident: 2026-04-18T09:42Z perf regression - prefix-cache hit-rate drop, rolling back kernel v3 deprecated for canary.

mira: Streaming edge-case: when `stream=true` we currently don't warm prefix cache because we assume low-latency ephemeral. But clients sometimes set streaming for partials and expect cache warmup. Maybe add `X-RW-Prefix-Warmup: true` to request warm caches on first token.

alex: Good idea. Also add `retry` behavior note: retry with streaming enabled can cause duplicate cache writes that evict good keys. Need idempotent cache writes or a compare-and-swap.

sam: Proposed action items:
- Add `X-RW-Prefix-Cache` header (opt-in/legacy/strict)
- Add `X-RW-Prefix-Warmup` header
- Make kernel_variant optional in key (config flag)
- Add metric: per-route prefix hit-rate, per-client, per-kernel
- Canary flag rollout and bump canary window

jordan: I'll open a PR for header parsing & SDK flag, include integration tests for streaming/retry.

alex: Thanks — please tag me on the PR. We'll run a 48h canary and watch `prefix_hit_rate` in grafana. :eyes: 

mira: FYI pseudocode for idempotent write:
```
if cache.exists(key): return
lock = cache.acquire_lock(compound_key)
if not cache.exists(key): cache.write(key, value)
cache.release_lock(lock)
```
This prevents duplicate writes on retries.

sam: I'll schedule a short playbook to rollback kernel keying on failure. cc @ops

ops: noted, prepping rollback runbook.

alex: cool — closing thread once PR merged and canary green.
